Gross external area 171 m² · net rooms ≈ 171 m² (incl. walls)
Highway drive-thru prototype — concept design (RIBA Stage 2)
Scale 1:50 @ A1 · dimensions in metres unless noted
Site geometry is a generic M4 roadside parcel; adapt to
topographic survey, title plan and Roads Dept. junction approval.
Linear 'production line' along the drive-thru façade: cold bar → espresso →
POS (W1) → food finish → hand-off (W2); every station faces the window lane so
Restrooms (2 accessible unisex + baby change) reached from the café lobby;
essential differentiator on the Sevan road.
Separate staff/delivery entrance on the west façade next to stores and the
Finishes: polished concrete floor, tuff feature walls, oak soffit exposed in
café, washable white panels in BOH (HACCP).
